questions.question: Write 3/4 as a decimal and as a percentage. Show your steps.
questions.expected_answer: Multiply the numerator and the denominator by 25 to get 75/100. 75 hundredths is 0,75, and 75 out of 100 is 75%.

questions.question: Order 3/5, 0,58 and 62% from smallest to biggest.
questions.expected_answer: Change them all to decimals. 3/5 is 6/10, which is 0,60, and 62% is 0,62. Comparing 0,58; 0,60; 0,62 gives the order 0,58; 3/5; 62%.

questions.question: The class takes R577,50 and spends R185,40 on ingredients. Work out the profit and check it.
questions.expected_answer: Line up the commas and subtract: R577,50 minus R185,40 leaves R392,10 profit. Check by adding R392,10 and R185,40, which gives back R577,50.
